name: Mii Amo
positioning: All-inclusive destination spa in Sedona's Boynton Canyon, where stays are booked as multi-night Journeys shaped with a personal Journey Guide
best_for: Guests aged 16 and over looking for an all-inclusive wellness retreat
Travelers drawn to Sedona's red rock canyons and vortex energy
Guests who want guided hikes, meditation and spa treatments built around a personal plan

facts.text: Mii amo is a resort spa located in Boynton Canyon in Sedona, Arizona.
Boynton Canyon is naturally shaped like a horseshoe and surrounds the resort.
Mii amo describes its setting as one of Sedona's major energy vortexes.
Mii amo was designed by co-owner and original architect Dana Tang of Gluckman Tang.
All accommodations include fireplaces, private outdoor spaces and heated bathroom floors, and are arranged within a quiet courtyard compound.
The casitas are arranged in a private enclave shaded by cottonwood trees.
Guests aged 16 and over can book all-inclusive Journeys of three, four, seven or 10 nights.
Journey packages include all taxes, gratuities and fees on accommodations, spa services, and food and beverage.
Journey packages include a daily credit for spa services or Trail House or Artist Cottage activities.
A personal Journey Guide works alongside each guest to create a Journey tailored to their needs.
The Boynton Canyon Vortex Hike leads from the resort to the energy center of Boynton Canyon and includes a guided meditation.
Hummingbird, the signature restaurant, sources seasonal produce from its own Chef's Garden and from nearby farms, ranches and orchards.

highlights.text: The Crystal Grotto is a circular space with an earthen floor and domed ceiling, centered on a petrified wood pedestal with a gentle fountain and an illuminated quartz crystal.
Once a year, on the summer solstice, a beam of sunlight through the Crystal Grotto's overhead aperture strikes the crystal.
The Luxury Suites have separate living areas, a private massage room, an outdoor shower and a large private courtyard with a fireplace and whirlpool.
The grounds include a Sensory Garden with a reflexology path, a labyrinth and a yoga lawn, all with views of the surrounding red rock walls.

considerations.text: Mii amo welcomes guests aged 16 and over only.
Journeys have set arrival days: three-night Journeys arrive on Thursdays and four-night Journeys on Sundays.
Mii amo is a secluded hideaway in Boynton Canyon, away from the hustle and bustle of downtown Sedona.
